_comment: The frozen contract, as data. This is EXACTLY the shape GET /api/runs/latest/findings returns. Build the console against this file and you never need the backend running. Do not change the field names — the service is being written against this same file.

findings.evidenceSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN t.actual_at <= t.scheduled_at + 300000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1788480000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1789084800000
  AND t.actual_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.vendor_id = 'V07'

SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN t.marshal_signed_in THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1788480000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1789084800000
  AND t.marshal_required
  AND t.site_id = 'SITE2'

SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN t.actual_at <= t.scheduled_at + 300000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1788480000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1789084800000
  AND t.actual_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN t.actual_at <= t.scheduled_at + 300000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1788480000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1789084800000
  AND t.actual_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.direction = 'logout'
  AND t.shift = 'S3'

SELECT avg(c.total_inr)
FROM costs c JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = c.trip_id
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1788480000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1789084800000
  AND t.vendor_id = 'V07'

SELECT avg(least(5.0, greatest(1.0, f.rating + 0.5 * f.sentiment)))
FROM feedback_normalised f JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = f.trip_id
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1788480000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1789084800000

SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN t.actual_at > t.scheduled_at + 900000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1788480000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1789084800000
  AND t.actual_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.mode = 'shuttle'

SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN t.actual_at <= t.scheduled_at + 300000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM trips t
WHERE t.scheduled_at >= 1788480000000 AND t.scheduled_at < 1789084800000
  AND t.actual_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.site_id = 'SITE1'
